limitations: These plans are not runnable adapters. A connector must validate its service-specific scope, identity, time semantics and continuation protocol before implementation.

plans.operation: Read an approved workspace query over a fixed UTC interval
plans.continuation: Use a documented stable paging strategy; record-limit truncation remains partial

plans.operation: Read approved incident metadata from an explicit workspace
plans.continuation: Validate the documented next link against the exact incident route before credentials

plans.operation: Read results of an explicitly authorized existing search job
plans.continuation: Bind offsets to the same completed job and distinguish job completion from result exhaustion

plans.operation: Read approved pipeline configuration metadata from an explicit group
plans.continuation: Verify the supported API version and paging contract; do not treat an undocumented response as complete
